newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling weakens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling weakens against the dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling weakened against the dollar and the pound on Wednesday, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 56.80 against the dollar from 56.35 on Tuesday. On the pound, it was posted at an average of 88.27 from 87.80 on Tuesday.
"Trade was lukewarm in early morning with the shilling holding the 56.35/50 range," a commercial dealer said. "Some interbank players offered dollars at 56.38 level."
"However, in early afternoon trade purchase orders from the oil sectors capped the shilling previous day gains," she said.
Another dealer added: "Despite comparable sales by exporters, the shilling lost further to close at 56.60/90."
"This movement could partly be explained by bargain hunters rush into the market to satisfy their orders for fear the dollar may not retreat. Range for the day is 56.60/90," he said.
Dealers said overnight money market rates dropped to average at 19 percent levels as liquidity returned to the market.
